effects.title: The main waterworks
effects.text: The middle marks meet both banks. Pump until the float reaches them, jump aboard, freeze the water, then cross to the drain on the far bank. Draining at the wrong height clears the channel safely.

effects.title: The old side channel
effects.text: The spring feeds the chiller through the outer pipes. The middle pipe spills water away. Open a path from the spring to the chiller without feeding the spill. Watch where the water actually runs.
